meta.name: Spanish for South American Travelers
meta.description: ~500 words and phrases for a beginner trip to South America. Sequenced from cognates to survival phrases to real-world scenarios.
meta.attribution: Original curation. Word frequency cross-referenced against doozan/spanish_data (CC-BY-4.0) and the RAE CREA corpus.
